scripts.start: npm run start:js & npm run start:css
scripts.start:js: cp node_modules/qrious/dist/qrious.min.js assets/js/qrious.min.js && wp-scripts start src/js/rrze-qr.js --output-path=assets/js --output-filename=rrze-qr.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: wp-scripts build src/js/rrze-qr.js --output-path=assets/js --output-filename=rrze-qr.min.js && cp node_modules/qrious/dist/qrious.min.js assets/js/qrious.min.js
scripts.lint:php: php -l rrze-qr.php && php -l includes/Main.php && php -l tests/php.php
